explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 76 named tracks across current September 2026 Clone charts, Bandcamp releases and Boomkat pre-orders, Resident Advisor's current field, adjacent June–August releases and overlooked catalogue windows. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The repaired opening remained outside placement testing: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried stay removed after severe listener feedback, while Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained.
Completed Runs 222, 223, 225, 227 and 228 selected identities and tested boundaries were excluded; unresolved, duplicate, rejected and untriggered PARKED identities were not reused.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, discoveries, target-local discovery pool, active rejection/PARKED state and the global utility ledger. Drift was not a prior lead even though other Exhale titles were inspected in Run 100.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer or repeats a selected-candidate boundary from the previous five completed discovery runs.

The three strongest leads come from three different releases and carry candidate-specific rhythmic or developmental evidence. Lower-ranked same-release and pre-release leads preserve their information limits instead of borrowing shared descriptions.

Explicit panic-, threat- and punishment-coded propositions were deprioritized after direct listener evidence from Sawa and Carried. This is a run-level selection decision, not a blanket genre or intensity ban.

ADJACENT CURRENT WINDOW: Batu & Donato Dozzy — Drift, released 2026-06-30; exact developmental evidence from Crack Magazine and the artists' Bandcamp. https://crackmagazine.net/article/profiles/batu-donato-dozzy-cover-story-interview/ ; https://batutimedance.bandcamp.com/album/exhale-2
